BONUS: From Trains to Tomatoes: How California’s Central Valley Builds More Than You Think (LIVE from Lodi)
articles.description:
Too many people just think of Silicon Valley and Hollywood when they think about the business side of California. But the I-5 corridor is one of the most important hubs of manufacturing in the world. Today’s live episode is set at M2 Wines in Lodi, CA, where our exploration of manufacturing in the breadbasket of California takes place in 3 parts.

First, we explore the Sacramento Valley and cover some industries that might not be the first to come to mind when we think of this area as we chat with Kevin McGrew of Siemens Mobility and President of the Sacramento Valley Manufacturing Alliance, Amy Schulz of Sierra College, Warren Kenzie of Orca Bio, and Scott Olson of Robert Bosch Semiconductor.

Second, we head down to the Central Valley, so to speak, for the next part of the interview as we talk to John Schneider, President of the Board of the Manufacturers Council of the Central Valley and Senior VP at Stanislaus Food Products, Darin Miller, Executive VP of The Wine Group, and Karen Warner, Founder and CEO of BEAM Circular, so a big food and bev focus in the middle of our episode.

And then finally, we wrap with a quick conversation with Lex Carlsson of Capitol Impact to discuss how California’s moving fast when it comes to innovation and why they continue to hold the title as the number 1 state for manufacturing in the US.
